simple.meaning: כָּרַע (kâraʻ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to bend the knee; by implication, to sink , to prostrate.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 36 times across Genesis, Numbers, Judges, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, and 8 more, beginning at Genesis 49:9. Its contexts include family line.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כָּרַע (H3766).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: כָּרַע (kâraʻ) / H3766 is traced through Genesis 49:9, Numbers 24:9, Judges 5:27, Judges 7:5 as a generated source-based concept entry.
